title: Why India Never Loses to Pakistan
sources: ODI World Cups India 8-0 Pakistan (last: 14 Oct 2023, Ahmedabad): NewsBytes, https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/sports/decoding-india-s-8-0-record-against-pakistan-in-odi-world-cups/story

Pakistan's last win over India: Asia Cup Super 4, 4 Sep 2022. ESPN calls the 3 Oct 2026 Asian Games final India's seventh straight T20I win over Pakistan; ODIs since 2022 (Asia Cup 2023, World Cup 2023, Champions Trophy 2025) all India wins or no result
T20 World Cup 2024, New York: India 119 all out beat Pakistan 113/7 by 6 runs. Olympics.com, https://olympics.com/en/news/t20-world-cup-2024-india-vs-pakistan-cricket-match-group-a-result-score

World Cup 2023, Ahmedabad: Pakistan 155/2 to 191 all out (8 wickets for 36). Free Press Journal, https://www.freepressjournal.in/sports/ind-vs-pak-cwc-2023-pakistan-collapse-from-1552-to-191-all-out-in-425-overs-in-ahmedabad

Asian Games men's final, 3 Oct 2026: India 211/6 beat Pakistan 192/6 by 19 runs. ESPNcricinfo, https://www.cricinfo.com/series/asian-games-men-s-cricket-competition-2026-1552449/india-vs-pakistan-final-1552779/match-report

lines.text: India just doesn't lose to Pakistan anymore.
At one-day World Cups, it's eight wins from eight,
and in over four years, Pakistan hasn't beaten them once.
So how does India keep doing it?
In twenty twenty-four, India were bowled out for just one hundred nineteen,
and still won by six runs.
In twenty twenty-three, they were cruising at one fifty-five for two,
then lost eight wickets for thirty-six runs.
And the latest? Just last month,
India beat them again, in the Asian Games final.
So, will Pakistan ever break the streak?
